facts.business: Velan Hotels Limited is in the business of providing hospitality services including running of restaurants with bar, but has suspended all business operations as of March 31, 2026.

auditor.name: Krishaan & Co.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to material uncertainty on going concern: company has suspended all operations, sold all income-generating assets, net worth eroded, and ability to continue as going concern depends on sale of remaining land assets.

key_risks: Company has suspended all business operations with no revenue generation
Net worth has been eroded indicating material uncertainty about going concern
Ability to repay debts depends on realization from sale of remaining land assets
Company has sold all income-generating assets
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties are in compliance with Section 177 and 188 of Companies Act, 2013 and details have been disclosed in the notes to financial statements as required by applicable accounting standards.
